repos.description: Open-source Windows and Office activator featuring HWID, Ohook, TSforge, and Online KMS activation methods, along with advanced troubleshooting.
repos.summary_zh: MAS 是一个开源的 Windows 和 Office 激活工具，支持 HWID、Ohook、TSforge 和在线 KMS 等多种激活方式，并提供高级故障排除功能。通过 PowerShell 脚本或传统 CMD 文件一键激活系统，适用于 Windows 8.1/10/11 及 Office 产品，集成自动化与跨平台支持。
repos.summary_en: MAS is an open-source activator for Windows and Office using HWID, Ohook, TSforge, and Online KMS methods, with advanced troubleshooting. It enables one-click activation via PowerShell or CMD scripts, supporting Windows 8.1/10/11 and Office, featuring automation and cross-platform compatibility.

repos.summary_zh: Magisk 是一款专为 Android 6.0+ 设备设计的开源定制工具，提供系统级 root 权限、模块化功能扩展及 Zygisk 动态注入能力，支持在不修改系统分区的情况下深度定制设备，广泛用于解锁系统限制、安装模块和高级调试。
repos.summary_en: Magisk is an open-source suite for customizing Android devices above Android 6.0, offering root access via MagiskSU, systemless modification through modules, and Zygisk for runtime code injection, enabling deep customization without altering system partitions.

repos.description: Clone any website with one command using AI coding agents
repos.summary_zh: AI网站克隆模板，通过AI编程代理一键逆向工程任意网站为现代化Next.js代码库。支持Claude Code等主流AI工具，自动提取设计元素、生成组件规范并并行构建页面结构，显著提升前端开发效率。
repos.summary_en: AI Website Cloner Template enables one-command reverse-engineering of any website into a modern Next.js codebase using AI coding agents. It automatically extracts design tokens, generates component specifications, and reconstructs pages through parallel builders, supporting major platforms like Claude Code for rapid frontend development.

repos.description: A simple app to use Xposed without root, unlock the bootloader or modify system image, etc.
repos.summary_zh: VirtualXposed 是一款基于 VirtualApp 和 epic 技术的 Android 应用，无需 root、解锁 bootloader 或修改系统镜像即可运行 Xposed 模块。支持 Android 5.0~10.0，适用于绝大多数非系统级修改的模块，如广告拦截、功能增强等。用户可在虚拟环境中独立安装应用与模块，并通过内置重启功能快速生效，极大提升了 Android 系统的灵活性与可玩性。
repos.summary_en: VirtualXposed is an Android app built on VirtualApp and epic that enables Xposed module usage without root, bootloader unlock, or system image modification. It supports Android 5.0–10.0 and works with most non-system modules like ad blockers and app enhancements. Users can install apps and modules in a virtual environment and reboot within the app for instant activation, offering a safe and flexible way to customize Android without system-level changes.

repos.description: A collection of GPT system prompts and various prompt injection/leaking knowledge.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库汇集了 ChatGPT 和自定义 GPTs 的多样化系统提示词，涵盖教育、编程、安全等多个领域。通过公开优质提示词案例，帮助开发者提升提示工程能力，同时揭示提示注入与安全防护策略，推动 AI 应用安全实践。
repos.summary_en: This repository compiles diverse system prompts for ChatGPT and custom GPTs across education, programming, and security domains. It enhances prompt engineering skills through real-world examples while exposing prompt injection vulnerabilities and defense strategies to promote secure AI application development.

repos.description: proxychains ng (new generation) - a preloader which hooks calls to sockets in dynamically linked programs and redirects it through one or more socks/http proxies. continuation of the unmaintained proxychains project. the sf.net page is currently not updated, use releases from github release page instead.
repos.summary_zh: ProxyChains-NG 是原 proxychains 项目的现代化延续，通过 LD_PRELOAD 技术劫持动态链接程序的 socket 调用，强制流量经 SOCKS4/5 或 HTTP 代理转发。支持 Linux、BSD、macOS 等主流平台，具备 IPv6、DNAT、多线程优化等特性，适用于绕过网络限制的场景，但需谨慎使用以避免法律风险。
repos.summary_en: ProxyChains-NG is a modern successor to the original proxychains project, intercepting socket calls in dynamically linked programs via LD_PRELOAD to route traffic through SOCKS4/5 or HTTP proxies. It supports Linux, BSD, macOS, and other platforms, featuring IPv6, DNAT, and multithreading optimizations. Designed for bypassing network restrictions, it requires careful configuration and legal awareness.

repos.summary_zh: LSPosed 是一个基于 Zygisk 的 ART 钩子框架，旨在提供与经典 Xposed 框架一致的 API 体验。它利用 LSPlant 实现核心 ART 方法钩取，支持 Android 8.1 至 16 系统，兼容原版 Xposed 模块，无需修改 APK 即可动态修改系统和应用行为，适用于 Magisk 环境。
repos.summary_en: LSPosed is an ART hooking framework based on Zygisk that delivers consistent APIs with the original Xposed. It leverages LSPlant for core ART method hooking, supports Android 8.1–16, and is fully compatible with legacy Xposed modules, enabling dynamic system and app behavior modification without APK changes in a Magisk environment.

repos.description: ChatGPT官网接口纯协议的逆向实现，支持GPT-Image-2模型、文本模型，兼容OpenAI接口协议，在线批量生图/编辑图，号池管理，支持可编辑PPT/PSD文件逆向，支持导入CPA、sub2api号池 、支持接入Cherry  Studio、New Api 等软件
repos.summary_zh: ChatGPT2API 是对 ChatGPT 官网能力逆向封装的 OpenAI 兼容 API 代理，支持文生图、图片编辑与多图组图功能，集成号池管理、多种账号导入方式及 Docker 自托管部署，提供完整的在线画图工作台与缓存机制。
repos.summary_en: ChatGPT2API is an OpenAI-compatible API proxy that reverse-engineers ChatGPT's image generation and editing capabilities, featuring account pool management, multi-import methods, Docker deployment, and a built-in online drawing workspace with caching support.

repos.description: 🚀 DeepSeek-V3 & R1大模型逆向API【特长：良心厂商】（官方贼便宜，建议直接走官方），支持高速流式输出、多轮对话，联网搜索，R1深度思考，零配置部署，多路token支持，仅供测试，如需商用请前往官方开放平台。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供 DeepSeek-V3 和 R1 大模型的逆向 API 接口，支持高速流式输出、多轮对话、联网搜索及深度思考功能，兼容 ChatGPT 接口标准，支持零配置部署与多账号 token 负载均衡，仅限个人测试使用，商用请转官方平台。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a reverse-engineered API for DeepSeek-V3 and R1 models, featuring high-speed streaming output, multi-turn conversations, web search, and deep reasoning. It is fully compatible with ChatGPT's API interface, supports zero-configuration deployment and multi-token load balancing, intended only for personal testing, commercial use requires official platform access.

repos.description: System-level Android AI Agent with direct OS access. | Android 系统级 AI Agent——越过沙盒，让模型访问底层API、屏幕、终端与你的数据
A search-first, profile-aware reverse-engineering workspace for AI agents — 735 tools across 36 domains in one MCP server.
repos.summary_zh: jshookmcp 是一个基于 MCP 协议的智能 JavaScript 分析工具平台，集成浏览器自动化、Chrome DevTools 调试、网络监控、智能代码钩子、LLM 驱动的反混淆与 AST 分析等功能。采用搜索优先的上下文优化策略，支持渐进式能力扩展与热加载插件，适用于逆向工程与安全分析场景。
repos.summary_en: jshookmcp is an AI-powered MCP server for intelligent JavaScript analysis, combining browser automation, CDP debugging, network interception, LLM-driven deobfuscation, and AST-level comprehension. It features search-first context efficiency, progressive capability tiers, hot-reload extensibility, and zero-wiring plugin discovery, ideal for reverse engineering and security analysis.

repos.description: A simple android app to enable Google Location Report, Google Now and related functions in China mainland or somewhere like.
repos.summary_zh: LocationReportEnabler 是一款专为中国大陆用户设计的 Android 应用，通过修改系统参数启用 Google 位置报告、Google Now 及相关功能。支持 ROOT 和 Xposed 框架两种模式，后者更稳定。核心功能包括设置运营商代码和 ISO 国家代码，以绕过地理限制，恢复 Google 服务的时间线功能。
repos.summary_en: LocationReportEnabler is a simple Android app designed to enable Google Location Report, Google Now, and related features in mainland China. It works by setting system properties like gsm.sim.operator.numeric and iso-country to bypass regional restrictions. Available in ROOT and Xposed variants, with the latter recommended for better stability and clarity.

repos.description: 🚀 即梦3.0逆向API【特长：图像生成顶流】，零配置部署，多路token支持，仅供测试，如需商用请前往官方开放平台。
repos.summary_zh: 即梦3.0逆向API服务，提供零配置部署的图像生成能力，支持多路token并发，兼容OpenAI接口标准，每日免费66次生成额度，适用于个人测试与学习用途。
repos.summary_en: Jimeng AI Free API service enables zero-configuration deployment of image generation via reverse-engineered API, supporting multiple tokens and OpenAI-compatible interface, offering 66 daily free generations for testing purposes.

repos.description: 🚀 MiniMax大模型海螺AI逆向API【特长：超自然语音】，支持MiniMax Text-01、MiniMax-VL-01模型，支持高速流式输出、语音合成、联网搜索、长文档解读、图像解析、多轮对话，零配置部署，多路token支持，自动清理会话痕迹，仅供测试，如需商用请前往官方开放平台。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目为MiniMax海螺AI提供逆向API服务，支持MiniMax-Text-01和MiniMax-VL-01模型，具备高速流式输出、语音合成与识别、联网搜索、长文档解读、图像解析及多轮对话能力。零配置部署，支持多路token并发，自动清理会话痕迹，接口兼容ChatGPT，适用于测试与个人使用。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a reverse-engineered API for MiniMax Hailuo AI, supporting MiniMax-Text-01 and MiniMax-VL-01 models. It features high-speed streaming output, speech synthesis/ASR, web search, document analysis, image parsing, and multi-turn conversations. Zero-configuration deployment, multi-token concurrency, session auto-cleanup, and full ChatGPT compatibility. For testing only; commercial use requires official platform access.

repos.description: A CLI for BOSS 直聘 — search jobs, view recommendations, manage applications via reverse-engineered API
repos.summary_zh: boss-cli 是一个基于逆向工程 API 的 BOSS 直聘命令行工具，支持职位搜索、个性化推荐、申请管理、与招聘者聊天及发送问候等功能。具备多浏览器 Cookie 自动提取、丰富筛选条件、结构化输出和跨平台支持，适用于求职自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: boss-cli is a CLI tool for BOSS Zhipin that enables job searching, recommendations, application management, and recruiter chat via reverse-engineered APIs. It supports browser cookie extraction, advanced filtering, structured output, and cross-platform usage for automated job hunting.

repos.description: 基于Go语言编写的ChatGPT官网接口纯协议的逆向实现GPT-Image-2生图，兼容多OpenAI接口协议，在线批量生成图像
repos.summary_zh: ChatGPT2API 是一个基于 Go 的 ChatGPT 官网接口逆向实现，提供 OpenAI 兼容的图片生成、编辑 API 及多模型文本处理能力。支持号池管理、CPA/sub2api 账号导入、Docker 自托管部署，并集成 React 前端创作台与权限管理系统，适用于非商业性技术研究与个人开发场景。
repos.summary_en: ChatGPT2API is a Go-based reverse-engineered implementation of ChatGPT's official interface, offering OpenAI-compatible image generation, editing APIs, and multi-model text support. It features account pool management, CPA/sub2api integration, Docker deployment, and a React frontend with creation studio and RBAC permissions—designed for non-commercial R&D use.

repos.summary_zh: LazyFox 是一个专为浏览器自动化与逆向场景设计的 Python 模板仓库，内置彩色日志、临时邮箱模块及两个站点流程示例。集成 Camoufox、Playwright 等工具链，支持快速搭建自动化注册、验证码抓取等 PoC 项目，适合二次开发但非生产级工具。
repos.summary_en: LazyFox is a Python template repository for browser automation and reverse engineering scenarios, featuring colored logging, temporary email modules, and demo flows for sites like Trae and Zenmux. It integrates tools like Camoufox, Playwright, and httpx, enabling rapid prototyping of automation scripts such as registration bots and email verification workflows—ideal for PoCs but not production-ready.

repos.description: 🛡️ Workspace file protection plugin for OpenClaw — guards against prompt injection attacks
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw Guard 插件为 OpenClaw AI 代理提供工作区文件防护，有效防御提示注入攻击。通过拦截外部会话的文件操作，自动屏蔽对身份、记忆等关键文件的读写，并将非关键写入重定向至沙箱目录，确保主会话权限隔离与系统安全。
repos.summary_en: The OpenClaw Guard plugin protects OpenClaw AI agents from prompt injection attacks by intercepting file operations in external sessions. It blocks access to critical files like identity and memory, redirecting non-sensitive writes to a sandboxed directory, ensuring secure agent isolation and integrity.
